approved: Labor supported the Defence Legislation Amendment (Instrument Making) Bill 2017, which updates three 30-year-old legislative instruments—the Defence (Inquiry) Regulations 1985, Defence (Areas Control) Regulations 1989, and Defence (Public Areas) By-Laws 1987—due to sunset in April 2018, to keep them fit for purpose without significant operational changes.

The bill amends the Defence Act 1903 to allow instruments such as the Defence (Inquiry) Regulations 1985, Defence (Areas Control) Regulations 1989, and Defence (Public Areas) By-Laws 1987—scheduled to sunset in April 2018—to be remade with modern policy requirements, consolidated provisions, and improved consistency.
